cells.gaps: No source found shows AI in service in two or more government bodies: DIVA's roll-out to 15 ministries is a plan. No rules or register for the government's own use of AI have been found.
cells.note: Fact 2025-12-08: the ICT ministry runs an existing government chatbot it is upgrading as DIVA, an AI system in service. The roll-out across ministries is still to come, so not stage 4.
